status: controller synthesis of four independent first passes; proposal for group review, not an adopted baseline

conventions.price_basis: real 2026 where converted; source price year retained in each record
conventions.energy: MWh; power in MW; daily energy E_t = 24 x MW_t
conventions.note: Every numeric record cites a package file. Records marked decision_required are not ready to be used as a single value.

parameters.value_rule: E_t = 24 * MW_t, one convention for every series and every scheme
parameters.evidence_strength: convention supported by the exact price identity (per_MW_day = 24 * per_MWh on 2,422 rows)

parameters.meaning: Common-date study window and continuity rule
parameters.scope: 2020-01-01..2026-09-17, 28 continuous segments, state restarts at each segment start
parameters.evidence_strength: reproduced by two independent implementations

parameters.value_rule: exclude 107 dates on which every dispatchable fuel is 0 MW, plus 2022-08-02; report all-days and excluded runs side by side
parameters.evidence_strength: 107 dates reproduced independently; block count differs (5 vs 9), date count matches

parameters.meaning: Electricity price used for merchant sales
parameters.value_rule: avg_price_GBP_per_MWh only; never multiply the GBP/MW-day column by 24 again
parameters.evidence_strength: arithmetic identity verified on all rows; index identity inferred from file name and BSC definition, not documented

parameters.scope: daily export <= min(available energy, cap*24); cap taken from the observed farm maximum
parameters.evidence_strength: observed maximum in the supplied data

parameters.value_rule: disabled in the minimum baseline; if enabled, require a non-zero adder and report break-even a* = 0.90*p_sell - p_buy
parameters.evidence_strength: no obtainable non-commodity import tariff; a=0 is known to be wrong from Ofgem cost decomposition
derived from round-trip efficiency 0.90

parameters.meaning: Battery installed CAPEX for a 2-hour system
parameters.scope: EPC/overnight installed, shallow connection, excludes deep reinforcement, land, decommissioning, VAT
parameters.evidence_strength: reconstructed from DEA storage catalogue cost elements; controller reproduced the arithmetic (0.271 x 1.10)

parameters.value_rule: 1.927 MW / 3.854 MWh per unit (Tesla Megapack 2 XL, 2-hour); continuous E in the LP, integer modules as robustness check
parameters.evidence_strength: manufacturer datasheet
brief; catalogue cross-check

parameters.scope: SOC 20-80%; implies 1.2 h at rated power for a nominal 2-hour asset
parameters.evidence_strength: brief; controller reproduced 0.60*E / (E/2) = 1.2 h

parameters.unit: equivalent full usable cycles per day
parameters.evidence_strength: modelling convention for daily data; no intraday information available

parameters.unit: EUR(2020) per kWh of energy capacity per year
parameters.evidence_strength: conflicting catalogue conventions; flagged, not resolved

parameters.unit: kWh per kg H2, AC, full system, beginning of life

parameters.value_rule: 20-100% of installed capacity with a binary on/off; 20% is a module-configuration floor, not a physical law
parameters.evidence_strength: manufacturer datasheets for three modules (12.5%, 20%, 25% floors)

parameters.scope: BEIS 2020 central 0.829 m GBP(2020)/MW_e uprated by an assumed 1.25; excludes compression
parameters.evidence_strength: arithmetic recomputed by the controller; the package's stated 1.50 does not follow from its own basis (CR-1)

ONS D7BT annual values

parameters.scope: sensitivity 10 and 20 years; annualise CAPEX or discount once, never both
